about.title: About Mesa Public Schools
about.content: Mesa Public Schools serves students in Mesa and the East Valley area of Maricopa County, Arizona. Its school-year calendar is especially useful for families because MPS schedules frequent two-hour early-release Wednesdays and separates professional learning days, semester exam early releases, grading-period end dates, and holiday breaks.

about.title: District Calendar and School-Level Schedules
about.content: This page summarizes districtwide Mesa Public Schools dates. Families should still check their school for bell schedules, transportation, athletics, testing, performances, graduation ceremony details, program calendars, and emergency updates.

planningTips.title: Mesa Public Schools Calendar Notes
content: Many MPS school years begin in late July or early August, so families should check the selected school year before making travel or child care plans.
Most Wednesday early-release dates are listed as two-hour early releases, but families should confirm exact bell times with their school.
High school semester exam dates use early-release schedules that may not affect elementary and junior high students the same way.
The calendar distinguishes full district office closures from school closures with limited district services.

districtFaqs.q: How early does Mesa Public Schools start the school year?
districtFaqs.a: MPS school years often begin in late July or early August. Check the selected school year for the exact first student day.

districtFaqs.q: Does Mesa Public Schools have regular early-release days?
districtFaqs.a: Yes. MPS calendars often list two-hour early-release Wednesdays, plus separate early-release dates for grading periods, parent-teacher conferences, semester exams, and the last day of school.

districtFaqs.q: Are Mesa professional learning days student attendance days?
districtFaqs.a: No. Professional learning days on the MPS calendar are no-school days for students. Families should plan child care or transportation differently on those dates.

districtFaqs.q: Where should families verify Mesa Public Schools calendar updates?
districtFaqs.a: Use the official Mesa Public Schools calendars page and school announcements for final confirmation. MySchoolDates is an independent reference and is not affiliated with Mesa Public Schools.
